name: Sun Cleric: Valkyr's Grip grants its 6% hit chance component (#5733)
contract: Valkyr's Grip 707072 (Spell.dbc; tooltip 'Allows you to dual wield and to wield a Two-Handed Mace, Sword, or Polearm in each hand and your chance to hit is increased by $707072s2%') has three effects: 0 SPELL_EFFECT_TITAN_GRIP, 1 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with ApplyAuraName 333 = SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (EffectBasePoints 5, DieSides 1 -> amount 6, matching the tooltip's $s2), 2 SPELL_EFFECT_DUAL_WIELD. AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) calls HandleModHitChance, and Unit::StatSystem.cpp's UpdateMeleeHitChances/UpdateSpellHitChances read GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT) and the spell-hit equivalent, so the 6% bonus is already a native, fully wired stat contribution with no CoA script needed. This scenario pins that contract directly: a control Sun Cleric without the talent versus one with it learned must differ by exactly 6 points of melee and spell hit chance.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Valkyr's Grip is learned and active
Valkyr's Grip adds 6 points of melee hit chance
Valkyr's Grip adds 6 points of spell hit chance
